svg.title: Symmetry-guided generative discovery workflow for topological materials — revised version
svg.desc: A four-stage workflow: composition- and space-group-conditioned SymmCD generation; MACE relaxation using FIRE then BFGS; high-throughput DFT, SOC band and symmetry calculations with IRVSP; accidental and symmetry-enforced degeneracy detection followed by phonon validation and three discovered materials.
svg.text: joint denoising of k, X′, A′ and S
